title: Cannot open the ledger database
hint: Reading the ledger failed at startup; the file may be corrupted. The app will not modify or delete your data file.
driftHint: The ledger database schema does not match what the app expects; the data itself is intact. The app will not modify or delete your data file — restoring from a backup is the recommended first choice.
aheadTitle: This ledger was created by a newer version of the app
aheadHint: The ledger was opened by a newer version before; the data is intact, but this installed version cannot open it. Upgrade the app to the latest version to continue — do not reset or restore, which would damage intact data.
upgradeChannelHint: Download and install the latest release, then open this ledger directory as usual — your data is unaffected.
upgradeButton: Open the releases page to get the new version…
resetChannelHint: Reset the unreadable ledger to a brand-new empty one and enter the app right away.
resetConsequence: After resetting, the current ledger data will no longer be accessible in this app.
resetBody: A brand-new empty ledger will be created and opened immediately. The unreadable database file is kept as a copy (ledger.db.bak in the ledger data directory) for inspection or external repair; an existing copy with the same name will be overwritten.
resetOk: Reset to a brand-new empty ledger
restoreChannelHint: Pick a backup file to restore your ledger to its state at backup time; the app restarts automatically after a successful restore.
